# How to Receive Money with nsave


Jonas Auernhammer


Feb 12, 2026


With nsave, freelancers, remote workers, and professionals can receive international payments safely in USD.


Whether you’re getting paid by an employer, clients on freelance platforms, or want to deposit funds yourself, this guide shows you every way to receive money with nsave.


### 1. Receive via Bank transfer (Salary or other payments)


Getting paid by an international employer or company? You can use your nsave USD account details. Simply share them with your HR or payroll department to receive your salary directly.


[How to receive your salary with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-receive-bank-transfers-ach-swift-with-nsave)


[How to receive ACH/SWIFT Bank Transfers →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-receive-bank-transfers-ach-swift-with-nsave)


### 2. Deposit Funds to nsave via Stablecoin


You can also fund your nsave account by depositing USD stablecoins (USDT or USDC) through the nsave[Web Portal.](https://web.nsave.com/sign-in?cb=%2Fcrypto) This option is ideal if you already hold digital assets and want to convert them safely into your USD balance.


! Deposits via stablecoin are only available on the nsave Web Portal. Not through the mobile app.


[How to deposit funds via stablecoin on nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-deposit-funds-to-your-nsave-account-via-stablecoin)


**Note:** npay USA Inc. including licensed US financial partners process Stablecoin related activities.


### 3. Receive Money from Upwork to nsave


Freelancers on Upwork can easily withdraw funds to their nsave USD account. Learn how to link nsave to your Upwork payment settings and get paid in USD without hidden conversion fees.


[How to receive Upwork payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-upwork-to-nsave)


### 4. Receive Money from Payoneer to nsave


Already getting paid via Payoneer? You can transfer your Payoneer balance to your nsave USD account securely and quickly.


### 5. Receive Money from Deel to nsave


If your company or client pays through Deel, you can add your nsave USD account as your preferred withdrawal method and receive funds seamlessly.


[How to receive Deel payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-get-paid-from-deel-to-nsave-complete-guide)

Freelancers using PeoplePerHour can connect their nsave USD account for fast and transparent withdrawals.


[How to receive PeoplePerHour payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-peopleperhour-to-nsave-complete-guide)


### 7. Receive Money from Freelancer.com to nsave


Working on Freelancer.com? You can link your nsave USD account to receive project payments efficiently and with lower fees.


[How to receive Freelancer.com payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-freelancer-com-to-nsave-complete-guide)


### 8. Receive Money from PayPal to nsave


Have funds in your PayPal account? You can easily transfer your PayPal balance to your nsave USD account using the bank transfer method. Perfect for freelancers and online sellers who receive payments through PayPal.


[How to receive PayPal payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-paypal-to-nsave)


### 9. Receive Money from Payoneer to nsave


Already getting paid via Payoneer? You can transfer your Payoneer balance to your nsave USD account securely using the bank transfer feature. Ideal for freelancers working on multiple platforms.


[How to receive Payoneer payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-payoneer-to-nsave)


### 10. Receive Money from Wise to nsave


Using Wise (formerly TransferWise) for international payments? You can send money from your Wise account directly to your nsave USD account with low fees and transparent exchange rates.


[How to receive Wise payments with nsave →](https://www.nsave.com/article/how-to-send-money-from-wise-to-nsave)


### Why Use nsave?


- Receive USD directly from employers or global platforms
- Add funds via stablecoin or supported payment providers
- Low fees, excellent conversion rates, and reliable transfers
- Swiss-level security and compliance
